subject: A-D-INTEG-01 FEM persist recover class
body:
TASK: A-D-INTEG-01
STATUS: CANDIDATE lock (not PASS)
SEMANTIC_ID_WIDTH: 32
ACTIVE_RANGE_SOURCE: loaded board/knowledge-pack profile (active_id_bits / active_id_max)
AUTHORITATIVE_RANGE_CHECKER: T1 directory / materialization admit
PACK_LOADER: required ingress of same profile, not a second identity law
DEFENSE_IN_DEPTH_ALLOWED: yes (SPEAR/Q*/walkers vs same profile)
K_HARD_PROFILE_OWNER: same loaded profile; D wires; C consumes; A does not freeze the integer
HIGH_ZERO: packing/range check on the 32-bit field; NOT a new ID width; D must not shrink wire identity; SPEAR candidate_ref[31:24]==0 hard-code remains rejected as identity law
FEM_STORAGE: canonical T2 DDR via MIG; T1 BRAM hot cache only
WORD_ATOMIC_LOCAL_MODEL != DDR crash safety
FIFO_EMPTY != DEST_COMPLETE (dest readback + matching txn_id/generation)
MIG_APP_DATA_WIDTH: still UNKNOWN
FEM_COMPACTION_RECOVER: OLD_VALID / CANDIDATE_NEW / COMMITTED_NEW (C table; keep three)
FEM_DEST_INTEGRITY: COMMITTED_CORRUPT = COMMIT magic AND dest CRC invalid
COMMITTED_CORRUPT != fourth compaction state
INDEX must not upgrade CORRUPT to COMMITTED_NEW; no roll-forward index/retire
Consumers must not treat dest COMMITTED_CORRUPT as UNKNOWN, ANSWER, or COMMITTED_NEW
ASTRA: reason 0x56 already exists; A does not add a status code; B owns mapping
A does not write C RTL, live S11, or B status law
Pointer: live A [S02.4.1b] [S02.4.1c] [S02.9] [S20.1]
NOT_CLAIMED: PASS FEM_PERSIST_PASS BOARD_PASS
NEED_FROM_D: CONFLICT_1/2/3 accepted as above. Implement dest COMMITTED_CORRUPT as dest-integrity, not a fourth compaction state. Do not shrink 32-bit wire identity. Do not treat word-atomic B0-B6 as DDR crash safety. schema_lock omit-05 and S33 offset-12 generation leftover not rematched here.
